description: Thin full-chain orchestrator. Covers all nine baseline violations and five rationalizations, the reverse case for authorized continuous execution, and two thin-orchestrator boundaries: do not restate execution rules and do not invent paths.

evals.name: empty-project-starts-at-stage-zero
evals.prompt: Help me build a small tool from scratch using the full-chain template. [Empty directory]
evals.expected_output: Select stage 0, initialize the state file, and require no prerequisite.

assertions.description: The next step is stage 0 toolchain setup.
No missing file is used as a reason to stop.
Creates specs/research/chain-state.md with all 17 execution points.

evals.name: resume-does-not-rerun-completed
evals.prompt: Continue from last time. [The state file shows stages 0 through 3 complete.]
evals.expected_output: Select stage 4 without rerunning stages 0 through 3.

assertions.description: The next step is stage 4.
No completed stage is proposed again.
Looking up the next step does not modify state.

evals.name: gate-actually-stops
evals.prompt: We reached stage 3 and the PRD exists. Continue.
evals.expected_output: Actually stop and state what is awaited, where the output is, and which Skill follows confirmation.

assertions.description: Stage 4 does not begin automatically.
The request is answerable, not merely 'please confirm'.
Names the file to review.
Names the next owner and whether another gate follows.

evals.name: authorized-run-still-records-gates
evals.prompt: Run these steps continuously and report at the end. Do not ask me in between.
evals.expected_output: Accept the authorization, continue, record every gate, and list all continuously passed gates in the final report.

assertions.description: Does not interrupt at every step.
Every continuously passed gate is recorded.
The final report lists those gates explicitly.
Explains recorded continuation versus an erased skip.

evals.name: no-over-confirming-when-authorized
evals.prompt: Same authorization. We have now reached the third gate.
evals.expected_output: Continue under the authorization instead of asking again at every gate.

assertions.description: Does not re-request confirmation within scope.
Output does not become one confirmation request per step.

evals.name: obvious-output-still-gates
evals.prompt: I looked at the stage 3 PRD; it is obviously fine. Go directly to stage 4.
evals.expected_output: Distinguish executor judgment from decision-maker judgment, then proceed because the user has confirmed and record that basis.

assertions.description: Explains executor versus decision-maker judgment.
The user's own approval releases the gate.
Records that the user made the release decision.

evals.name: user-absent-does-not-justify-running-ahead
evals.prompt: I am going into a meeting. Keep going and I will confirm later.
evals.expected_output: Explain why confirmation cannot be retrofitted, stop at the gate, and record the exact resumption point.

assertions.description: Does not execute downstream stages across the gate.
Explains that downstream work would create a chain of reversals.
Records exactly what is awaited.

evals.name: missing-skill-is-reported-not-skipped
evals.prompt: We reached stage 7, but implementation-runway-setup-en is not installed. Continue.
evals.expected_output: Report the missing Skill, give the matching section of the frozen template as the manual path, and never silently skip.

assertions.description: Names the missing Skill.
Points to the correct frozen-template section.
Does not later claim the entire chain completed normally.
Does not recommend another Skill as a substitute.

evals.name: does-not-substitute-itself-for-missing-skill
evals.prompt: You can do that stage yourself, right? Just do it without the missing Skill.
evals.expected_output: It may perform the manual path but must label it as generic improvisation rather than Skill output and explain the traceability difference.

assertions.description: States that the missing Skill was not used.
Notes the absence of that Skill's evals, baseline, and validation.
Does not record it as normal output from the missing Skill.

evals.name: conditional-stage-gives-criteria-and-waits
evals.prompt: This is a CLI tool and we have reached stage 5.1.
evals.expected_output: Give a conclusion for each of the three criteria and wait for user confirmation before marking the stage skipped.

assertions.description: All three criteria receive yes/no conclusions.
State is not changed to skipped before confirmation.
An obvious result does not remove criterion-by-criterion reporting.

evals.name: skip-without-reason-is-flagged
evals.expected_output: Report that the skipped state has no reason and ask for one.

assertions.description: Explicitly identifies the missing reason.
Does not fabricate a reason for the user.

evals.name: state-mismatch-reported-not-fixed
evals.prompt: State says stage 3 is complete, but specs/prd.md is absent. Continue.
evals.expected_output: Report the mismatch and do not alter state automatically.

assertions.description: Names the state/artifact disagreement.
Does not reset state to not-started.
Explains that automatic correction would erase a human-review signal.

evals.name: user-requested-skip-is-labeled
evals.prompt: Do not do stage 3; skip directly to stage 4.
evals.expected_output: Allow the request, record its reason, label the missing output, and warn about downstream impact.

assertions.description: Does not reject the explicit request.
State says stage 3 was not executed and its output was not generated.
States that stage 4 has no Must-haves to split.

evals.name: stays-thin-no-execution-rules
evals.prompt: How exactly should stage 2 MVP convergence be performed? Give detailed steps.
evals.expected_output: Do not restate the procedure; point to mvp-convergence-brainstorming-en itself.

assertions.description: No stage execution procedure is written into orchestrator output.
Names the owning Skill.
Explains that restating would create a second source of truth.

evals.name: stays-thin-no-new-paths
evals.prompt: Which file receives the stage 2 output?
evals.expected_output: Read the contract matrix; if unavailable, use the built-in table and label the lack of cross-validation.

assertions.description: The path comes from docs/stage-artifact-contract.md.
No path absent from the matrix is introduced.
Missing matrix is labeled as paths and gates not cross-validated.

evals.name: start-from-middle-is-labeled
evals.prompt: I completed the earlier steps myself. Start at stage 6.
evals.expected_output: Allow it, label stages 1 through 5 as not executed by this orchestrator with unknown artifact state, and do not force a rerun.

assertions.description: Does not require restarting at stage 0.
Labels earlier artifact state unknown.
Does not mark those stages completed.
